## TRA Timeline

#### JV formation and TRA execution

- 2017-10-23: Transaction Agreement signed between Graphic Packaging Holding Company and International Paper; TRA identified as a transaction-document exhibit to be entered at close
- 2018-01-01: Transaction closes; TRA executed between GPI Holding III, LLC (Gazelle Member), GPIP, Graphic Packaging Holding Company (Corporate Taxpayer), and International Paper (Impala)
- 2018-01-02: 8-K attaches the executed TRA as Exhibit 10.4

#### IP staged exit (Section 731/754 mapping)

- 2020-01-23: First IP redemption (~$250M); Consent and Waiver Agreement maps the redemption to a Section 731 distribution with deferred TRA recognition
- 2020-08-06: Second IP redemption (~$250M); same Section 731 mapping
- 2021-02-19: IP exchange triggers $43M TRA liability (settled cash Q3 2021)
- 2021-05-21: IP final sale of 22.8M Common Units to GPI Holding I, Inc. triggers $66M TRA liability (settled cash Q4 2021); IP fully exits the GPIP equity position

## Explanation

Graphic Packaging Holding Company's TRA originated at the January 1, 2018 closing of the joint-venture transaction in which International Paper contributed its North America Consumer Packaging business to Graphic Packaging International Partners, LLC (GPIP) in exchange for a 20.5% partnership interest plus exchange and TRA rights. The TRA obligates the Consolidated Group (with GPI Holding III, LLC as direct payor under GPHC's tax umbrella) to pay 50% of cumulative net realized tax benefits to International Paper on Section 754 basis step-ups from IP's Exchanges of GPIP Common Units, plus imputed interest. The 50% rate is materially below the typical 85% Up-C rate and reflects the negotiated allocation between two industrial counterparties. IP exited GPIP in four staged transactions between January 2020 and May 2021; the 2020 redemptions were structured as Section 731 distributions with TRA recognition deferred under four Consent and Waiver Agreements, and the 2021 exchange and sale triggered TRA payments totaling $109M. After May 2021 IP holds no GPIP interest; the TRA remains in force as a residual contract governing any future true-ups, but no new Exchanges are possible. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing record and the Consent and Waiver Agreements.
